title: padus virginiana var. leucocarpa
intro: Padus virginiana var. leucocarpa, commonly known as Chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub native to Eastern North America, characterized by its edible blue-black berries and white flowers. The health benefits of Chokeberry include its potential to support cardiovascular health, boost antioxidant levels, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Chokeberry include its use as a diuretic, astringent, and anti-diarrheal agent, making it a valuable remedy for various digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Chokeberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant effects.
